recipe.title: Herb Turkey Breast with Roasted Sweet Potatoes
recipe.summary: Herb-roasted turkey breast with sweet potatoes, green beans, and a cranberry Dijon drizzle.
recipe.story: A fall-forward sheet-pan dinner that keeps turkey breast juicy and gives it a bright cranberry Dijon finish without turning the meal into full Thanksgiving dinner.
recipe.serving_size: 5 ounces cooked turkey breast with roasted sweet potatoes and green beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless turkey breast, raw
20 ounces sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
1/4 cup Ocean Spray Whole Berry Cranberry Sauce

ingredient_sections.title: Herb Turkey & Vegetables
items: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless turkey breast, raw
20 ounces sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredient_sections.title: Cranberry Dijon Drizzle
items: 1/4 cup Ocean Spray Whole Berry Cranberry Sauce

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

Add the sweet potatoes to one side of the sheet pan. Toss with 2 teaspoons avocado oil, half of the garlic powder, half of the onion powder, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and a little of the salt and pepper.
Roast the sweet potatoes for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the turkey breast into large, evenly sized pieces.
Toss the turkey with the remaining avocado oil, minced garlic, remaining garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Remove the sheet pan from the oven. Add the turkey and green beans alongside the sweet potatoes.
Return to the oven and roast for another 15 to 18 minutes, or until the turkey reaches 165°F and the sweet potatoes are tender and browned.
Whisk together the cranberry sauce, Grey Poupon, water, and apple cider vinegar.
Divide the turkey, sweet potatoes, and green beans evenly among four servings.
Drizzle each serving with one-fourth of the cranberry Dijon sauce.
freezer_storage: Divide into four individual freezer containers.
Freeze the cranberry Dijon sauce separately when possible so the vegetables keep their texture.
reheating_instructions: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator when possible.
Microwave for 2 minutes, stir or rearrange the food, then continue in 30-second increments until heated through.
Add the cranberry Dijon drizzle after reheating.
tips: The cranberry Dijon sauce gives lean turkey breast a distinct fall flavor without overwhelming it.
Use an instant-read thermometer and cook turkey to 165°F.
